lineage.old_results: AAI-10A 129.10x Linux/200.84x Windows vs fastest conventional; AAI-10B 16.048x Linux/22.921x Windows after 8.18x/8.69x old-source speedup. Both frozen negative. No retune/replay.

hypothesis: An independent tokenless causal learner using a fixed 3-slot bank of bounded 9-hypothesis operator mismatch sufficient statistics, causal contradiction gating and protected operator signatures can learn and retrieve explanatory causal laws from action consequences without rescanning old observations, at <=2.0x whole development-process cost of the fastest same-information conventional learner, and with lower stored bytes; any true transfer advantage remains unverified until separately authorized science.

frozen_candidate.name: BoundedCausalSignatureBank
frozen_candidate.architecture: three protected causal-signature slots, 9 public two-input XOR/AND/OR hypotheses per each of two observed mediators; no tokens, transformers, labels or privileged simulator info
frozen_candidate.evidence: only exact public x(3), mediator pair(2), goal(2), observed reward and action count; each observed pre-state and post-state counts as one public event
frozen_candidate.slot_state: stable slot ID, exactly two length-9 integer mismatch counters, row_count, two length-9 small nonnegative prior penalties; zero raw stored observations
frozen_candidate.hypothesis_selection: MAP minimum (mismatches + prior_penalty), stable original public 9-operator order tie breaker; output prediction Bernoulli 0.95 for selected hypothesis output 1, 0.05 otherwise; no hidden-law lookups
frozen_candidate.switching: on each pair of public observations, active and dormant slots evaluated on exactly 4 publicly observed mediator bits using their own MAP predictions; if a dormant slot has >=1 fewer mismatches than active, select lowest mismatches then oldest slot ID; do not allocate in same batch as recall
frozen_candidate.novelty: only when no dormancy recall, active has >=8 learned observations, and active MAP predictions disagree on >=2 of the 4 observed outputs of current pair; if available, create fresh slot with operator-reuse prior; otherwise update active
frozen_candidate.operator_prior: when creating new slot, for each output penalize hypotheses whose operator (XOR/AND/OR) differs from the best hypothesis on the oldest protected slot with >=8 observations by exactly +1 mismatch-equivalent; never use hidden-law labels; no prior if no eligible protected slot
frozen_candidate.updating: upon pair commit, for each public (x,mediator) event increment total rows seen and for each of 2 outputs×9 hypotheses increment mismatch counter by 1 exactly when that publicly observed bit differs from hypothesized mediator; saturate at 96 by refusing excess training rows? Instead cap only by active slot final cap 96 events total per slot; if over cap, require explicit failure (no silent forgetting); retained inactive slots immutable
frozen_candidate.planning: same shared AAI-10A `models.plan` planner on `predict` outputs, plus ephemeral per-version decision cache keyed by x,goal,actions_taken; deterministic stop/tie semantics unchanged; internal cache not in checkpoint
frozen_candidate.cold: byte-canonical sorted JSON serializable source state; independent restore has empty ephemeral decision cache, strict state bounds, stable IDs and validated counters
frozen_candidate.ablation: same source bank single-slot (max_slots=1) with no operator prior
frozen_candidate.timing: full lifecycle train 128 explicit synthetic public events + cold canonical checkpoint restore + 12 shared planner decisions, median of 3 isolated repetitions; compare to all original matched controls on same events and machine, no speed tuning after result

admission.semantic: synthetic teacher-less exact public observation validation and no hidden fields; every slot counter reflects only public evidence
admission.mechanistic: on hand-built distinct A/B phases, ability to hold up to 3 slots and return to prior slot under contradictory input; no hardcoded law labels anywhere in model code
admission.frozen_controls: reuse all AAI-10A conventional controls exactly unchanged, including tabular_recent16 as old fastest, symbolic_all/recent8/recent16, tabular_all, logistic_interactions 1200-epoch, symbolic_bank; compare candidate and one-slot ablation, AAI-10A original candidate as separate diagnostic; privileged oracle excluded
admission.dev_efficiency: candidate whole seconds / fastest eligible matched conventional <=2.0 on both Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows 2022 (2× hard ceiling); candidate serialized bytes <= fastest conventional bytes on both
admission.source: cross-OS deterministic canonical checkpoint SHA256 and chosen policy trace identical on synthetic source; all data from public rows
admission.science: zero first-use cohorts consumed; runner disarmed and output labeled DEV mechanical; no post-result retune or replay
admission.full_regression: 54/54 repo + 8/8 AAI-10P + 10/10 AAI-10A + new AAI-10C focused tests per OS on final candidate exact SHA with clean generated G29 atlas
